description: Squad selection map for NovelKit subagents on Hermes. A novel's PROJECT_DNA.md declares `sub_agents_squad` (and optional `sub_agents_squad_secondary` when hybrid). The Orchestrator resolves the squad directory under subagents/, then loads each role's SOUL.md as the system prompt for the corresponding Hermes subagent (Requirements 3.2, 3.4). Genre aliases below are preserved verbatim from the legacy dispatcher's SQUAD_BY_GENRE so an unspecified squad can be inferred from the primary genre.

selection.primary: Read `sub_agents_squad` from PROJECT_DNA.md; if absent, infer from primary `genre` via genre_to_squad. Value must be one of valid_squad_families (allowlist).
selection.secondary: When hybrid, read `sub_agents_squad_secondary` (or infer from `genre_secondary`); primary squad still owns dispatch.
selection.role_lookup: Within the resolved squad directory, scan <role>/SOUL.md and match by Role; the Orchestrator (Lãng Khách) lives at subagents/orchestrator/SOUL.md.

orchestrator.note: Hub-and-spoke coordinator; does not write prose. Specialists never talk directly to each other (CONTRACTS hub-and-spoke).

authority_note: SOUL.md provides role specialization but MUST NOT override shared canon under skills/novelkit-canon/canon/system/* (Requirement 3.3).
